documents.title: Constitution of the Independent State of Papua New Guinea
documents.issuing_authority: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
documents.reviewer_notes: Verification in progress. The previously recorded Parliament-hosted PDF returned a 404 error during an access attempt. The PNG Ombudsman Commission provides an alternative Constitution page; its document version and amendment coverage still need verification. The PNG Judiciary library directs researchers to PacLII for the Constitution and PNG cases. Constitutional Amendment No. 48 concerns motions of no confidence; obtain the enacted text and authoritative Supreme Court judgments to establish its precise legal effect. Constitutional Amendment No. 49 concerns PNG's Christian identity; its certification, commencement and current legal status remain to be established from authoritative records. Compare available constitutional texts, investigate later amendments, and confirm redistribution permissions before approval.
